facts: **Copper** (Energy Spark) — Cashews | Sesame Seeds | Shiitake Mushrooms | Dark Leafy Greens
**Manganese** (Bone Builder) — Pineapple | Brown Rice | Pecans | Mussels
**Selenium** (Cell Shield) — Brazil Nuts | Sardines | Sunflower Seeds | Turkey
**Calcium** (Signal Sender) — Sardines with Bones | Bok Choy | Almonds | Yogurt
**Potassium** (Fluid Balancer) — Swiss Chard | Butternut Squash | Coconut Water | Lima Beans
**Chromium** (Blood Sugar Helper) — Broccoli | Grapes | Barley | Oats

caption:
Copper quietly runs the show for your energy levels — it helps your body actually absorb and use the iron you eat, so without enough copper, even an iron-rich diet can leave you running low on fuel. Manganese works behind the scenes in collagen production, meaning it's not just about bone strength but also how well your joints and skin hold up over time. And iodine is the one your thyroid can't function without — too little, and your metabolism basically runs in slow motion, even if everything else in your diet looks perfect. Everyone's body is different, so pay attention to how yours responds.
